attempted_claim: Determine the orientation-preserving inertia group I(CP^9) = {[Σ^18] ∈ Θ_18 : CP^9 # Σ^18 is orientation-preservingly diffeomorphic to CP^9}; equivalently, determine exactly the kernel of the degree-one collapse map f^*_{CP^9}: π^s_18 = π̃^0(S^18) → π̃^0(CP^9) under Θ_18 ≅ π^s_18.
decisive_failure: The S^{-5} dual stage was shown to induce a 2-local pi0-isomorphism, narrowing the gap to a single S^{-3} iterated Toda bracket, but the Adams E2 Massey-product and hidden-extension computation deciding 2h2h4 could not be closed locally; published tables and index theory give only the Z/2-or-Z/4 interval. No emergent finding is claimed and no artifacts beyond the worklog are asserted.
